Override.Name: Override World Settings
Override.Hint: Use custom fog shading values for this scene instead of the module's world settings. Changes preview live on the canvas while this scene is being viewed.

Enabled.Name: Enable Fog Shading
Enabled.Hint: Turn off to fall back to Foundry's default fog rendering (applies instantly, handy for comparing).

NeverFog.Name: Never Fog: Outside
NeverFog.Hint: While at least one of your tokens is outside, the map outside buildings is always shown and only buildings with a faded roof get fog. While all your tokens are inside, everything uses normal fog. Tokens always need line of sight, and fog memory is unaffected. A building is a roof tile (Fade, Radial or Vision occlusion) or a Roof Level.

RevealedDarkness.Name: Never Fog: Darkness
RevealedDarkness.Hint: How dark always-shown areas are when outside your line of sight. 0 = full map brightness.

RevealedSaturation.Name: Never Fog: Saturation
RevealedSaturation.Hint: Colour saturation of always-shown areas outside your line of sight. 0 = greyscale, 1 = original colours.

UnexploredDarkness.Name: Unexplored: Darkness
UnexploredDarkness.Hint: How dark never-explored areas are. 0 = full map brightness, 1 = solid black (Foundry default).

UnexploredSaturation.Name: Unexplored: Saturation
UnexploredSaturation.Hint: Colour saturation of never-explored areas. 0 = greyscale, 1 = original colours.

ExploredDarkness.Name: Explored: Darkness
ExploredDarkness.Hint: How dark explored areas that are not currently in sight are. 0 = full map brightness, 1 = solid black.

ExploredSaturation.Name: Explored: Saturation
ExploredSaturation.Hint: Colour saturation of explored areas not currently in sight. 0 = greyscale, 1 = original colours.

SceneDarknessInfluence.Name: Follow Scene Darkness
SceneDarknessInfluence.Hint: How much the scene's darkness level further darkens fogged areas, so night scenes don't show brighter fog than lit areas. 0 = ignore scene darkness.

RoofLevel.Name: Roof Level
RoofLevel.Hint: Treat this Level's background as a roof. Its opaque pixels (see Alpha Threshold) are the roof. With Never Fog enabled, the area under a faded roof gets normal fog. Use roof tiles for separate buildings.
RoofLevel.Fade: Whole level: fades entirely while a token is under it
RoofLevel.Vision: Vision: see-through only where your tokens can see

DisableNeverFog.Name: Disable Never Fog
DisableNeverFog.Hint: This Level always uses normal fog, even with Never Fog: Outside enabled. Use it for basements, caves, sewers or any level that's indoors without a roof above it.

HideRoofs.Name: Hide Roofs (GM)
HideRoofs.Hint: Toggle all roofs (roof tiles and Roof Levels) hidden on your screen until toggled again, to see and edit what's beneath. GM only; players are unaffected.
